target_reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” Proc. ACM Interact. Mob. Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, 2021, Art. no. 171, doi: 10.1145/3494975.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该综述论文将目标论文作为侧信道声音感知中基于RFID的典型工作之一进行引用，在相关工作中提及了其through-wall eavesdropping能力，但未给出详细描述或评价。

evidences.evidence_quote: Through-wall eavesdropping has been demonstrated utilizing various techniques such as...RFID [23]...
evidences.evidence_context: Through-wall eavesdropping has been demonstrated utilizing various techniques such as laser Doppler vibrometry (LDV) [5], millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar [6], [7], visual sensing [8], WiFi [9]–[11], RFID [23], and other modalities [24].

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用出现在介绍through-wall eavesdropping技术的列举句中，仅作为RFID技术的代表之一，没有描述目标论文的具体能力或亚毫米级精度，属于普通相关工作中；目标引用标记[23]正确引用目标论文。
